explanation: OEIS A368635 (g.f. A(x) = 1 + 3xA(x)² − 2xA(−x)²), P. D. Hanna: 'a(n) is odd when n = 2^k − 1 for k >= 0 and even elsewhere.' The formal recurrence uses the fact that [x^m] is (3 − 2(−1)^m) times [x^m]A², i.e. factor 5 for even n and 1 for odd n, consistent with the DATA 1, 1, 10, 21, 310, …. The statement Odd (a n) ↔ ∃ k, n = 2^k − 1 matches. Faithful.
